speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Onchocerciasis (River Blindness).

Your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, combined with a pruritic rash on the face/upper body and neuropathy in the palms, strongly suggests infection with the parasitic worm *Onchocerca volvulus*, likely transmitted by blackflies. Do you have any history of eye pain, vision changes, or visible skin nodules?
